components.text: Filter items give the Item Routing system its matching logic. Right-click one to open its configuration screen: place up to 9 reference items in the grid (they're kept as a template, not consumed) and toggle whitelist/blacklist mode with the button.

$(item)Standard Filter$() matches an exact item. $(item)Tag Filter$() matches any of a reference item's tags. $(item)Mod Filter$() matches by the mod a reference item comes from. $(item)Enchantment Filter$() matches any of a reference item's enchantments (an unenchanted reference matches unenchanted items instead).

$(item)Composite Filter$() nests other Filter items instead of reference items, combining them with its own whitelist/blacklist button repurposed as an OR/AND toggle: match if ANY nested filter matches, or only if ALL of them do.
Once configured, right-click an Input/Output Routing Node or an Item Router with the Filter in hand to install it - see those entries for details.
